summary: Submission-gate QA for Where Nature Leads (Phase 6b). Verified: movement regression fix (no console errors, sprint reaches 6.42 m/s vs 6.5 target), the new Interactive Tutorial state machine (all 6 steps advance correctly, tutorial_done flag persists), Continue-skips-tutorial (no hint renders), Guardian ending logic (endingKind='guardian' at health 90+share=95), Settings persistence across reload, README numeric accuracy (build 234.61 kB JS + 12.70 kB CSS matches exactly; React/ReactDOM 19.0.0; Three.js 0.161.0; Google Fonts @import present in index.css), and Credits screen does NOT expose 'Emergent'/'Claude' strings while retaining 'TXG Nagaland Game Jam 2026'. Two minor deviations vs review spec found in the tutorial deferral & Continue paths (see frontend_issues). Ending card DOM did not render in headless due to forced cinematic._t fast-forward — the underlying choice/ending state is correct.

ui_bugs.issue: When window.__wnl.pause() is called programmatically, tutorial._deferred stays False and the tutorial-hint DOM element remains visible. Root cause: Game._loop (Game.js:622-626) returns early when _paused=true, BEFORE reaching tutorial.update(dt) at line 709 — so Tutorial._shouldDefer() never runs to set _deferred=true. In real gameplay the Pause Menu overlay likely masks the hint visually, but the review requirement is strict: '_deferred should become true and the hint DOM element should disappear'. Fix: either call tutorial.update() before the paused early-return, or directly toggle deferred state in Game.pause()/resume().

After Continue with tutorial_done flag saved, window.__wnl.tutorial._done reads False (spec says True). Behavior IS user-visible-correct — tutorial.active=false, no hint renders — because Tutorial.start() is only chained onto the opening cinematic onEnd (Game.js:497-500), and Continue skips that cinematic so start() (which is where _done is set from the flag) never runs. Fix: also read the flag into tutorial._done in the Continue-load path so the internal state matches the spec.

integration_issues.flow: Ending card render via test-hook path
integration_issues.issue: startFinalChoiceSequence() + click choice-share-btn + cinematic._t=60 correctly sets gameState.endingKind='guardian' and health=95, but the [data-testid='ending-card'] DOM element never mounts in the same test run. Forcing cinematic._t forward too fast likely skips the emit that mounts the card in GameApp.jsx. Not a gameplay bug — in a real un-forced play-through the card renders normally (verified in iteration 3). Recommend a direct hook like window.__wnl.showEndingCard(kind) for headless QA.

action_items: MEDIUM: Fix tutorial deferral so window.__wnl.pause() causes tutorial._deferred=true and hides the hint DOM. Either move tutorial.update() above the paused early-return in Game._loop, or directly toggle deferred + emit hint(null) from Game.pause()/resume().

critical_code_review_comments: Game.js:622-626 vs 709: tutorial.update(dt) is unreachable while _paused=true. If deferral is meant to work on pause, either the update call must run before the pause return, or Game.pause() must directly notify the tutorial. The current Tutorial._shouldDefer() code path is dead code for the _paused branch.

Tutorial.start() (Tutorial.js:80-95) is the only place _done is initialised from the persisted flag. Because start() is only chained onto opening_cinematic.onEnd (Game.js:497-500), a Continue flow that skips the opening cinematic leaves _done=false even if the flag is true. Consider hoisting the flag-read to a constructor pass, or calling start() on both New Game and Continue paths (start() has an idempotent 'already done' short-circuit).

Tutorial.js:99 emits 'tutorial_hint' event. If _emitHint(null) is used to clear the hint, gameState listeners should be robust to a null payload — verified by reading Game.js:265-270 forwarding — LGTM.

CharacterController smoothing + Character yaw spring behave correctly at runtime (confirmed by tutorial reaching step 1 which requires sprinting+moving; peak sprint speed 6.42 m/s asymptotes toward 6.5 m/s target).

rca_of_the_issue: Tutorial deferral: Game._loop returns at line 622-626 when this._paused===true, BEFORE calling tutorial.update(dt) at line 709. Therefore Tutorial._shouldDefer()'s `if (g._paused) return true` branch is unreachable via the paused path — the tutorial simply stops receiving update ticks and its _deferred stays whatever it was (false), leaving the hint DOM in place. Fix: hoist tutorial.update() above the paused return in Game._loop with dt=0 (so it can observe pause state without advancing timers), OR mutate tutorial._deferred + emit tutorial_hint(null) directly from Game.pause() and re-emit the current step's text from Game.resume().
